entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to start a return for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor.
Okay, I can look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?

Got it. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered on December 15th, 2025. Before I proceed, can I ask what specifically is the issue with the device? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

It's just not for me. Frankly, I found it **hard to use**. The whole interface is pretty **confusing**, and I **expected more** for the price. I even read the **user manual** and it didn't help. So, yes or no, can I return it?

Yes, absolutely. I see here that your item was delivered 27 days ago. Our knowledge base shows a 90-day return window, so you're well within that timeframe. I can process this return for you right now.
Great. Finally, a simple answer. What's the next step?

I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on file. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it at any post office. Once we receive the item, a full refund will be issued to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
You're welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today for VeloFit?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
